text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Creek, I have heard from others that<n>today is your
birthday.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If I may be so bold as to ask, what<n>sort of thing are
you interested in? I<n>would like to present a proper
gift, as<n>thanks for everything you've done.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, Yaeno! You don't need to be so<n>formal with
me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, but thank you. It's more than<n>enough to
know that you care.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
No! Feelings alone cannot possibly<n>suffice. Please,
at least choose from<n>one of these.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If by land, a bear. If by water, a<n>shark... I would
offer something of<n>great strength, though it's a
mere<n>fraction of what I owe.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh my... You're so strong, Yaeno.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But I think bears and sharks would<n>be awfully
startled if they saw you<n>coming.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
So... how about this? Let's make bear<n>and shark
candies to put on top of a<n>cake. ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'll teach you how to make them, so<n>you can make
my present all by<n>yourself.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I must craft candies... U-understood. If<n>that is your
wish, I shall do it—no<n>matter the hardship!
